prompt: This is a painting of a cherry blossom forest in the hazy morning mist. The branches in the foreground are painted thickly to present a three-dimensional texture. The edges of the petals are smudged with light golden morning light. The mist in the middle is dragged with a scraper to create a silk texture. The background is blended with gray-blue wet painting. The style is based on the Impressionist light and shadow processing. The main colors are pink/fog gray/light gold. The bottom of the picture is dotted with sporadic blue-purple February orchids.
